title: Finite-level comparison for constant Qbar-l cohomology
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $K$ be an algebraically closed field in which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $X$ be a separated finite-type $K$-scheme. Write $\mathbf Z_\ell\subset\mathbf Q_\ell\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ for the coefficient rings [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure]. For $n\geq1$ let $F_n=\underline{\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z}$ be the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, with the usual quotient transition maps, and use ordinary finite-level etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. On the left below, use ordinary adic cohomology: derived global sections of the completed constant integral coefficient object with finite reductions $F_n$, rationalized at $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and then extended to the common finite-stage category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete, def-weil-pbc-rational-category, def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. The notation does not mean cohomology of a discrete constant non-torsion sheaf on the small etale site.

Assume that $H^j(X_{\mathrm{et}},F_n)$ is finite for every $j\geq0$ and $n\geq1$. There are natural $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-linear isomorphisms, for every $q\geq0$,
$$
H^q_{\mathrm{adic}}(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)\cong
\left(\varprojlim_{n\geq1}H^q(X_{\mathrm{et}},F_n)\right)\otimes_{\mathbf Z_\ell}\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell.
$$
The inverse limit uses the maps induced by $F_{n+1}\to F_n$. These identifications commute with the maps induced by constant sections $\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z\to H^0(X_{\mathrm{et}},F_n)$.
